verdict.rationale: Lever's own AI features page documents 'AI Interview Transcripts and Summaries' that automatically capture interview conversations and generate recaps for hiring managers. That covers the record, transcribe and summarize core of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows summaries flowing into the scorecard or any handling of candidate recording consent. Missing for 10: summaries distilled into scorecards, candidate consent handling, in-depth docs on recording/transcription mechanics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a hiring manager, interviews get AI notes and summaries — recorded, transcribed, and distilled into the scorecard with candidate consent handled

citations.quote: AI Interview Transcripts and Summaries automatically capture conversations and generate actionable recaps, helping recruiters and hiring managers stay focused, speed up feedback, and make decisions faster.
